notes: WArmy 0.4.6: fixes the authorization label reverting to Normal after a reply, and a pending-queue deadlock that left every later message queued forever when a long task ended through the continuation broadcast. Reply right-click menu is now Copy/Quote/Translate/Translate selection (selection-gated), and link menus no longer overlap. nm viewer: run executables via Ctrl+Enter or the context menu; fixed panels being covered, blank pages and split-toolbar height; address-bar buttons can be reordered, collapsed into the overflow menu and dragged back out; incognito tabs use neutral styling and an icon; in-page search and four new toolbar icons. Localized brand names for 23 locales (WArmy / local brand / local tagline); Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and Japanese unchanged.
